test: none: a regression between SolidCraft 0.30.1 (truck) and 0.40.0-rc.2 (solidcore); the report's script
summary: SolidCraft 0.40 refuses a chamfer round the top rim of a cylinder whose rim has a rounded notch, at every distance, with 'not supported yet: the chamfer is larger than the faces beside its edges allow'; 0.30.1 builds it (#12435). The report's script: a cylinder R35 x 10 on the origin, a R7.25 cylinder from z = -1 to 11 at x = 36.5 cut out of it, the notch's two vertical edges rounded R5 (picked at (34.3108, +-6.9116, 5)), so the top rim is one tangent-continuous chain of four arcs (R35, R5, the concave R7.25 notch, R5), and a 1 mm chamfer picked at (-35, 0, 10) with tangent propagation on, which blends the whole chain. Replayed with solidcraft-cli built on GitHub's runners (fork SychPL/solidcraft branch fork-ci-12435, run 42665966667): main 5c99792a and v0.40.0-rc.2 refuse the chamfer at 1, 0.5, 0.2 and 0.05 mm with that message and build the controls, the plain cylinder's rim chamfer (38375.601462) and the rounded notch (37859.371278); v0.30.1 builds all six. SolidCraft's chamfer runs the fillet session's chamfer preparation (FilletSession::prepare_chamfers_along, through solidcraft-smlib's chamfer_edges). This fixture's chamfer step is SmApiFilletEdges with a linear section and rolling-ball radius d, as in SolidCraft #2672's case; on these right-angle edges it is the same chamfer, legs d on the top and on the wall, but it does not reach the refusal: on solidcore every case builds. The cases carry SolidCraft's chamfer-cone fix fillet_chamfer_cone_on_arc; the second fix it then ran with, storing that revolution as its cone, has since become the only path (a fork probe: with both, the volumes of all of SolidCraft's fixes, to 4e-8). With them the plain rim's chamfer is an exact cone (2.3e-7 off), but on the chain the four chamfer faces are cones of face tolerance 1.6e-4, 16 times the body's 1e-5, and the volume is 0.0074 to 0.0079 mm^3 low at every distance, above each case's tolerance: those cases fail. Without the two fixes (measured while both were options) the chamfer is fitted with B-spline faces: 0.013 to 0.015 low with no fixes (the plain rim 0.016), within 0.001 with every other fix of SolidCraft's (the plain rim too). Expected volumes are closed form: the area inside the rim by Green's theorem over its four arcs (the R5 rounds' centres at (28.523116, +-9.296872), where |C| = 30 and |C - (36.5, 0)| = 12.25), times 10, less the chamfer, by Pappus arc by arc: 0.5 d^2 * angle * (r - d/3) on the three convex arcs and (r + d/3) on the concave notch. The arcs meet tangentially, so their normal sections tile the chamfered band. A randomised QMC of the top 1 mm slab (scrambled Sobol, 32 x 2^18 points, point membership by the distance to the rim) lies 0.20 standard errors from it, and the rc.2 and main CLI volumes of the controls agree within 3.9e-7. Tolerance per case: 1e-8 of the volume (the integrator's accuracy, 3.8e-4) plus 1e-5 times the area of the rounds and the chamfer (what faces anywhere within the body's 1e-5 tolerance of exact could change), rounded up: 0.002 to 0.005 mm^3. From 0.2 mm up it is below what legs 0.1% off would change (0.0089 mm^3 at 0.2 mm, 0.22 at 1 mm). The pick points are exact edge points: the notch's edges where the two circles cross, (2504.6875/73, +-sqrt(35^2 - x^2), 5), and the rim's arcs at (-35, 0, 10), (29.25, 0, 10) and the R5 rounds' midpoints.

cases.name: plain_cylinder_rim
cases.note: Control: the same 1 mm chamfer on the top rim of the cylinder without the notch, one circular edge. solidcraft-cli on SolidCraft main 5c99792a and v0.40.0-rc.2 builds it, 38375.601462; v0.30.1 builds it.

volume.formula: pi*35^2*10 - 0.5*1^2*2*pi*(35 - 1/3) (Pappus: the chamfer's triangle, centroid 1/3 in from the wall); tol 0.004 mm^3

cases.name: rounded_notch
cases.note: Control: the notched cylinder with the notch's two vertical edges rounded R5, before the chamfer. solidcraft-cli on SolidCraft main 5c99792a and v0.40.0-rc.2 builds it, 37859.371278; v0.30.1 builds it.

volume.formula: 10 * the area inside the rim (Green's theorem over its four arcs: R35 about the origin, R5 about (28.523116, +-9.296872), R7.25 about (36.5, 0)); tol 0.002 mm^3

cases.name: rounded_notch_rim_chamfer_1
cases.note: The report's chamfer, 1 mm, on the whole tangent chain of the top rim: its four edges, as SolidCraft's tangent propagation picks them from one. On SolidCraft main 5c99792a and v0.40.0-rc.2, solidcraft-cli refuses it ('not supported yet: the chamfer is larger than the faces beside its edges allow'); v0.30.1 builds it.
